tidbit: Did you know… about 7,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
DeepSeek has open-sourced Super-Agent, a coding agent that reads team chats. Reported by The Next Web: the tool aims to reduce human coding coordination with artificial intelligence.
Anthropic's cofounders pledge 80% of their stock to charity, including employee matching and public good funds. Reported by Business Insider: the company says helping others is core to its mission.
Anthropic's cofounders pledge 80% of their stock to charity, with employee matching and public good funds. Reported by Business Insider: the company has big plans to give back.
A user found Gemini helpful for discovering light, personalized shows instead of relying on Netflix's own algorithm. Reported by Android Police: the tool addressed decision paralysis better than Netflix's recommendations.
OpenAI has raised 11 billion dollars of a 30 billion dollar target. Reported by Pasquale Pillitteri: the company has cut its target to 20 billion dollars.
